newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies four muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies four muni issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp. said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following four municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Johnston, Iowa, $2.305 million general obligation refunding bonds and $2.13 million GO refunding bonds.
--New Haven Community Schools, Mich., $7.85 million school building and site bonds.
--Osceola Township Public Schools, Mich., $3 million school building and site bonds.
--Honeoye Falls Central School District, N.Y., $8.097 million GO school district bonds.
